verdict.rationale: Gumloop has a dedicated Human in the Loop feature explicitly designed to pause an agent workflow and require approval before sensitive actions proceed, plus an 'Ask Question' ability for human input, and app rules to configure when this happens. This directly matches the ops story of pausing for human approval/input mid-workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and detail on how the paused state is resumed or surfaced to approvers (e.g., notification channel specifics).
